text:
Alice (PM): heads up — competitor QuickServe launched per-tenant routing + tiered embedding pricing. ACME + MerchantPilot pinged CS asking if we can match. Thinking: do we accelerate a 'lite routing' ship or keep focused on long-term per-tenant SLAs? Need decision this week.
Ben (Eng): lite routing likely doable without infra changes: use smart-routing tags + routing policy flag. Roughly 2 engineers x 6 weeks. No dedicated infra or billing hooks though.
Dana (ML): note: lite routing won't cover tenant-specific quantization or token budgeting. It gets us parity on routing surface-level but not unit-cost guarantees.
Mark (Sales): ACME said they'd delay pilot unless we can promise tenant-level controls (not full SLAs) within 90 days. They can be a launch customer for lite if we have per-tenant settings in Console.
Leah (Eng-Infra): billing hooks + per-tenant metering are non-trivial — ~3 weeks of infra work to add tag-based metering to pipeline. If we scope lite to 'soft controls' (console flags + routing policy), we can defer billing work.
Maya (Design): rollout needs guardrails. Suggest canary config + a 'tenant opt-in' toggle. Success metrics: p95 latency delta <= 10%, cost delta <= 15%, and <1% error rate increase.
Sanjay (CTO): recommend 2-track approach: 1) Ship 'routing-config-lite' as an ops-config-only canary in 6 weeks. 2) Start infra spike for billing + SLA capability for Q3. Approve 2 engs for lite route.
Alice (PM): decision recorded. I'll open tickets: PROD-xxx for routing-lite, INFRA-yyy for billing spike. Action items: Ben assign engs, Leah scope infra epic, Dana provide perf checklist, Maya mock console UX by next Tue. @Mark can you confirm ACME interest for canary?
Mark (Sales): I'll confirm today and loop legal on pilot contract language. ACME wants SSO + audit logs too.
Ben (Eng): quick config example to illustrate 'lite' approach:
```
routing_policy: {
  tenant_tag: 'acme',
  preference: 'low_cost',
  fallback: 'std'
}
```
Will work with Console team.
Leah (Eng-Infra): noted — I'll add SLO rollback steps and a billing-events shim in the infra epic.
Alice (PM): sweet. We'll hold roadmap sync tomorrow 10am to align with SRE on rollback playbook. Low-risk ship but still need canary plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sanjay (CTO): :thumbsup:
